Nelson County, Virginia Tax Sales: Easy Guide to Public Property Auctions

Nelson County, Virginia holds public tax sales to recover unpaid property taxes. These auctions give buyers and investors a chance to purchase real estate at competitive prices while helping the county collect overdue revenue. If you’re looking to get involved, here’s how it works in simple steps.

Click Here to Get Dustin Hahn’s Tax Lien and Deed FREE Mini-Course

When Tax Sales Happen in Nelson County

The county schedules tax sales only when properties qualify—there’s no annual calendar.

  • Timing: As needed, based on delinquent properties
  • How to Stay Updated: Check the Auction Calendar or public notices

Time and Location of the Auction

Auction details are shared in official notices before each sale.

  • Start Time: Most auctions begin at 12:00 PM (Eastern Time)
  • Where It’s Held:
    • Nelson County General District Court Courtroom
    • The exact address is listed in the auction notice

Registration Process

You must register ahead of time to bid at any auction.

  • Is Registration Required? Yes
  • When to Register:
    • Starts when the auction is announced
    • Ends before the sale begins (check notice for the deadline)

Can the Property Still Be Redeemed?

Yes—but only until the day of the sale.

  • Before the Auction: Owners can pay their taxes to stop the sale
  • After the Auction: The redemption period ends

Bidding and Payment Terms

Winning a bid means following some key payment steps.

  • Who Wins: Highest bidder
  • Deposit Requirement:
    • Due immediately after winning
    • Amount and payment type are listed in the sale terms
  • Buyer’s Premium:
    • May apply—check the sale notice for percentage and minimum
  • Deed Type: Special Warranty Deed
    • Any recorded easements or legal agreements will still apply

Where to Get Info and Updates

You can find current listings and official auction notices here:

  • Nelson County Treasurer’s Tax Auctions Page
  • Public Auction Announcements

Contact Info for Help

Reach out if you have questions or need more details:

  • Nelson County Treasurer’s Office
  • Email: treasurer@nelsoncounty-va.gov
  • Phone: (434) 263-7060

Smart Tips for Nelson County Tax Sales

Before you attend a tax auction, keep these tips in mind:

  • Homes with vineyards or cabins can attract short-term rental interest; factor that into your evaluation.
  • Spending time on title research is valuable—some lots come with lengthy ownership histories.
  • Consider properties with rough access roads; minor improvements might yield significant rewards.
